identificationModule.briefTitle: Weekly Cisplatin or Nedaplatin Concurrent With Intensity-modulated Radiation Therapy in Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized Phase III Study of Concurrent Weekly Nedaplatin or Cisplatin With IMRT in NPC Patients

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a randomized Phase III study to evaluate efficancy of weekly cisplatin or nedaplatin concurrent with Intensity-modulated radiation therapy in Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma (NPC).

armGroups.label: Low dose cisplatin arm
armGroups.description: concurrent chemotherapy: cisplatin 20mg/m2,weekly,for 6 cycles during radiotherapy

armGroups.label: High dose cisplatin arm
armGroups.description: concurrent chemotherapy: cisplatin 30mg/m2,weekly,for 6 cycles during radiotherapy

armGroups.label: Low dose nedaplatin arm
armGroups.description: concurrent chemotherapy: nedaplatin 20mg/m2,weekly,for 6 cycles during radiotherapy

armGroups.label: High dose nedaplatin arm
armGroups.description: concurrent chemotherapy: nedaplatin 30mg/m2,weekly,for 6 cycles during radiotherapy

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Pathologically confirmed untreated NPC patients
* T1-2N1-3M0 or T3-4NxM0
* 18-70 years old
* with MRI examinations
* ECOG ≤ 2
* With written consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* With a second cancer
* Pregnancy
* With other severe diseases (blood,liver ,kidney or heart diseases)
* Could not be staged properly
* Without written consent
